body 1 x at first violating step 8 after close approach to body 2 at distance 1.41 with momentum jump

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.019418252852807093 to 0.001 with same 8 steps; finer integration removes close-approach error so momentum stays conserved

explanation: Ledger open: momentum drift at close approach; ruled out: initial-condition effects (conserved exactly steps 0-7). Pairwise softened gravity should preserve total momentum by equal-opposite forces. At step 8 bodies 1-2 close to 1.41 with high speeds (body1 ~8.4) and strong acceleration; the adaptive substep split (11 substeps) is too coarse, producing asymmetric integration error and net momentum gain (~0.26 vector change). Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the failure, confirming timestep/substep-accuracy cause.
vision_note: The two upper bodies stay in close proximity while the third small body remains far away near the bottom. Through step 8 there is only slight drift of the close pair with no visible jump, ejection or wall interaction.
